title: claude-jsonl 1 entry
description: One line of a Claude Code transcript, the `raw` column of the entry and message tables. Partial: the fields listed are the common and useful ones; a line carries more. Measured on Claude Code 2.1.29x transcripts, October 2026. Read a value with json_extract(raw, '$.path') after scoping rows to content_format 'claude-jsonl 1'.

type.description: The record kind. user, assistant, system, and attachment carry the conversation envelope below; the others are session state records that carry only `sessionId` and their own fields.

uuid.description: This record's id; the entry table's uuid column

parentUuid.description: The uuid of the record this one follows; null on the first

timestamp.description: RFC 3339; the entry table's timestamp column

sessionId.description: The native session id, the transcript's file stem

version.description: The Claude Code version that wrote the line

entrypoint.description: How Claude Code was run: cli, claude-vscode, sdk-cli

isSidechain.description: True on a sub-agent's own transcript

isMeta.description: True on a user row the harness wrote rather than the person

isCompactSummary.description: True on the user row holding the summary a compaction wrote in place of the dropped turns

subtype.description: On system rows: stop_hook_summary, turn_duration, local_command, compact_boundary, informational, model_refusal_no_fallback, model_refusal_fallback, and others

message.description: On user and assistant rows. On an assistant row this is one API response, written as one row per content block: every row of a response repeats the same `id` and `usage`. Count a response once by grouping on `message.id`.

id.description: The API response id, shared by every row of one response; absent on user rows

model.description: The model that produced the response; the session table's model column takes the first

content.description: A string for a plain prompt, else the content blocks of this row

usage.description: The response's token usage, repeated on every row of the response

stop_reason.description: end_turn, tool_use, max_tokens, or null while streaming

toolUseResult.description: On a user row carrying a tool_result block: the tool's result as the harness recorded it, the value of the tool_use table's result_raw column. An object for most tools, a string on an error. The shape per tool is in the tool_use_result schema.

requestId.description: On assistant rows: the API request id

apiBlockIndex.description: On assistant rows: this row's index among the response's content blocks

permissionDecision.description: On tool-result rows: how the call was approved

promptId.description: On user rows: the prompt this row belongs to

sourceToolAssistantUUID.description: On tool-result rows: the uuid of the assistant row holding the tool_use block

hookCount.description: On system stop_hook_summary rows, with hookErrors, hookInfos, toolUseID, stopReason, preventedContinuation

attachment.description: On attachment rows: content the harness injected beside a turn

totalCostUSD.description: On cost-state rows, with modelUsage per model and the duration and line totals; the last row is the running total

block.description: One content block. `type` selects the fields: text has text; thinking has thinking and signature; tool_use has id, name, input, and caller; tool_result has tool_use_id, content, and is_error.

id.description: The tool call id; the tool_use table's id column

name.description: The tool name; the tool_use table's name column

input.description: The call's arguments; the tool_use table's input_raw column

content.description: The result text or blocks as the model saw them
